scope: Experimental map display only; no production qualification or analytical identity change
rationale: The current approximately 8 fps camera views can display adjacent frames about 87 ms apart. The explicitly authorized demo tolerance permits roughly one camera frame.
otherGuards: Same shared ID, target ID and fusion epoch
Own current camera calibration and session
No averaging, proximity alias, count fusion or trail stitching

validation.controls: 149/150 ms join;151 ms and150 ms+1ns split. New1.01m group fails;established1.08m group stays with CURRENT representative position;1.51m splits. Member/session/epoch/time/visibility/frame/calibration change clears continuity. Workspace commit is covered.

distancePolicy: New groups require <=1 m. An established exact group may persist through current-position jitter up to 1.5 m. A split requires <=1 m to rejoin. No previous position, frame, event or analytical identity is reused.
